I don’t know what Corvane will charge after March 31, 2027. The current rate is **$0.08 per ACH payout** through then, and the 2027 pricing memo uses that same rate for planning—not as a confirmed renewal rate [1].

I searched for Corvane’s renewal pricing and read the pricing memo and the Nov. 16 #finance update. Marcus said Corvane had hinted at an increase but hadn’t put anything in writing; the renewal call was moved to the week of Nov. 23 [1][5].
